chapter.heading: Psalm 34
Taste and See That the LORD Is Good
(1) Of David, when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, so that he drove him out, and he went away.
chapter.v: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
be glad.
and let us exalt his name together!
and delivered me from all my fears.
and their faces shall never be ashamed.
saved him out of all his troubles.
around those who fear him, and delivers them.
Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!
for those who fear him have no lack!
seek the Lord lack no good thing.
I will teach you the fear of the Lord .
see good?
speaking deceit.
pursue it.
and his ears toward their cry.
cut off the memory of them from the earth.
and delivers them out of all their troubles.
the crushed in spirit.
but the Lord delivers him out of them all.
not one of them is broken.
and those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
condemned.

footnotes.footnote: 34:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet
